公司.zh: 我们公司明年要搬到新的办公室。
公司.en: Our company will move to a new office next year.

公司.zh: 这家公司做得很大，很有名。
公司.en: This company has grown big and is very famous.

公司.zh: 公司放假了，大家都出去玩。
公司.en: The company is on holiday, everyone is going out to play.

公司.zh: 因为公司业绩不好，所以很多人失业了。
公司.en: Because the company's performance was poor, many people lost their jobs.

不要.zh: 不要担心，一切都会好的。
不要.en: Don't worry, everything will be fine.

不要.zh: 你要记住，不要对陌生人说话。
不要.en: You must remember, don't talk to strangers.

不要.zh: 如果下雨，就不要出去了。
不要.en: If it rains, don't go out.

本.zh: 那本笔记本是我最喜欢的。

本.en: Can you lend me a book?

本.zh: 他每本作业都写得很认真。
本.en: He writes every homework assignment very carefully.

回.en: I will return to school tomorrow.
He went back to his hometown for the New Year.

回.zh: 我已经回过一次北京了。
回.en: I have already been to Beijing once before.
When are you going back to the company?

回.zh: 如果他不回电话，我就再打一次。
回.en: If he doesn't return the call, I'll call again.

东西.zh: 你手里拿的是什么东西？
东西.en: What is that thing in your hand?

东西.zh: 我买了好多东西，袋子都快装不下了。
东西.en: I bought a lot of things, the bag is almost too full.

东西.zh: 这个东西很好吃，你要不要尝尝？
东西.en: This thing is very tasty, do you want to try it?

东西.zh: 他东西掉地上了，你快帮他捡一下。
东西.en: He dropped something on the floor, go help him pick it up.

东西.zh: 我不知道这些东西放在哪里，你帮我找找吧。
东西.en: I don't know where these things are placed, please help me find them.

三.en: I drink three cups of water every day.

三.zh: 他等了三个小时，终于见到她了。
三.en: He waited for three hours and finally saw her.

三.zh: 这家店在三楼，我们坐电梯上去吧。
三.en: This shop is on the third floor, let's take the elevator up.

三.zh: 如果你三天不吃饭，肯定会很饿。
三.en: If you don't eat for three days, you will definitely be very hungry.

买.en: I'm going to buy a bottle of water.

买.zh: 你想买什么颜色的衣服？
买.en: What color clothes do you want to buy?

买.zh: 她昨天买了很多水果，有苹果和香蕉。
买.en: She bought a lot of fruit yesterday, including apples and bananas.

买.zh: 这个手机太贵了，我买不起。
买.en: This phone is too expensive, I can't afford it.

买.zh: 我们买票的时候忘了带身份证，结果没进去。
买.en: When we bought the tickets, we forgot to bring our ID cards, so we didn't get in.

问.en: I want to ask you something.

问.zh: 老师问了我一个问题，我没回答出来。
问.en: The teacher asked me a question, and I couldn't answer it.
Ask him what time he gets off work.

问.zh: 别一直问东问西的，安静一会儿。
问.en: Stop asking all kinds of questions, be quiet for a while.

问.zh: 如果你不知道路，就去问那个穿红衣服的人。
问.en: If you don't know the way, go ask that person in red clothes.

岁.en: I am twenty years old this year.
His son is three years old, very cute.
How old were you when you started learning English?

岁.zh: 奶奶八十多岁了，身体还很健康。
岁.en: Grandma is over eighty years old and still very healthy.

岁.zh: 这个孩子才五岁，就已经会背很多古诗了。
岁.en: This child is only five years old, but he can already recite many ancient poems.

号.zh: 我的手机号是一三八开头。

号.en: What size shoes do you wear?

号.zh: 我们约好三号见面，你可别忘了。
号.en: We agreed to meet on the 3rd, don't forget.

朋友.zh: 我有两个好朋友，一个是小李，一个是小王。
朋友.en: I have two good friends, one is Xiao Li and the other is Xiao Wang.

朋友.zh: 你朋友多不多？要不要一起出去玩？
朋友.en: Do you have many friends? Want to go out and play together?

朋友.zh: 他最近交了一个新朋友，两个人天天一起打球。
朋友.en: He recently made a new friend, and the two of them play ball together every day.

住.zh: 我住学校附近，走路五分钟就到。
住.en: I live near the school, it's a five-minute walk.

住.zh: 他住的那个小区环境很好。
住.en: The neighborhood where he lives has a very good environment.

住.zh: 我们住酒店的时候，记得带身份证。
住.en: When we stay at a hotel, remember to bring your ID.

住.zh: 你住这么远，上班方便吗？
住.en: You live so far away, is it convenient for you to go to work?

件.en: I bought a new piece of clothing.

件.zh: 他昨天做了一件很傻的事。
件.en: He did a very stupid thing yesterday.

件.zh: 我有两件重要的事要告诉你。
件.en: I have two important things to tell you.

件.zh: 你帮我看看这件衣服好不好看？
件.en: Take a look at this piece of clothing for me, does it look good?

那些.zh: 你还记得那些年我们一起玩的日子吗？
那些.en: Do you still remember those days when we played together?

那些.zh: 那些问题太难了，我一个都不会。
那些.en: Those questions are too difficult, I can't answer any of them.
Don't touch those things, they are very dangerous.

水.en: This glass of water is too dirty.

水.zh: 今天太热了，我想喝冰水。
水.en: It's too hot today, I want to drink iced water.

水.zh: 水龙头坏了，一直在滴水。
水.en: The faucet is broken, it's been dripping.
He drinks eight glasses of water every day.

水.zh: 因为水太烫，我放了一会儿。
水.en: Because the water was too hot, I let it sit for a while.

写.zh: 我每天写日记，记录生活。
写.en: I write a diary every day to record life.

写.zh: 如果你有空，帮我写封信吧。
写.en: If you have time, help me write a letter.

写.zh: 我们写完作业以后就去玩。
写.en: After we finish homework, we'll go play.

您.en: May I ask what help you need?
You sit first, I'll be right there.

您.zh: 如果您不介意，我想问您一个问题。
您.en: If you don't mind, I want to ask you a question.

您.zh: 您有空的时候可以来找我聊聊天。
您.en: When you have free time, you can come chat with me.

电话.zh: 他刚才给我打了一个电话。
电话.en: He just gave me a call.

电话.zh: 因为电话没电了，我打不通。
电话.en: Because the phone battery died, I can't get through.

电话.zh: 如果电话响了，你帮我接一下。
电话.en: If the phone rings, answer it for me.

女.en: This female teacher is very gentle.

女.zh: 他有一个女儿和一个儿子。
女.en: He has one daughter and one son.

女.zh: 女的坐在左边，男的坐在右边。
女.en: The women sit on the left, the men sit on the right.

女.zh: 因为她是女生，所以让着她。
女.en: Because she is a girl, so be nice to her.

分.en: I give you a score of ten points.
One hundred points is full marks.

分.zh: 如果你能考到九十分，我就奖励你。
分.en: If you can score 90 points, I'll reward you.

小时.en: Sleeping eight hours a day is best.
This movie is two hours long.

小时.zh: 因为堵车，我多等了一个小时。
小时.en: Because of traffic, I waited an extra hour.

小时.zh: 虽然只过了两小时，但我觉得很久。
小时.en: Although only two hours passed, I felt it was a long time.

有些.en: Some things are hard to say.
It's a bit cold today, wear more.
Some people like to wake up early.
I'm a bit tired, I want to rest.

有些.zh: 虽然有些难，但我会坚持。
有些.en: Although it's a bit difficult, I will persist.

日.en: On Sunday we go out to play.

日.zh: 这个项目需要三十日完成。
日.en: This project needs to be completed in thirty days.

日.zh: 生日那天他收到了礼物。
日.en: On his birthday he received gifts.

日.zh: 从今日起，我要好好学习。
日.en: From today on, I will study hard.

玩.en: Let's hang out on the weekend.
Children like to play with building blocks.
We had a lot of fun.

玩.zh: 如果你写完作业，就可以出去玩。
玩.en: If you finish your homework, you can go out and play.

正在.zh: 他正在洗澡，等会儿回你电话。
正在.en: He is taking a shower and will call you back later.

正在.zh: 虽然我正在忙，但是可以听你说。
正在.en: Although I'm busy, I can listen to you.

正在.zh: 我正在等公交，突然下雨了。
正在.en: I was waiting for the bus when it suddenly started raining.

喝.en: He drinks two cups of coffee every day.

喝.zh: 你喝什么？喝可乐还是果汁？
喝.en: What do you want to drink? Cola or juice?

喝.zh: 因为天气太热，所以我想喝冰水。
喝.en: Because the weather is too hot, I want to drink ice water.

喝.zh: 她喝了一口汤，觉得太咸了。
喝.en: She took a sip of soup and found it too salty.

穿.zh: 今天穿这件外套很合适。
穿.en: This jacket is very suitable to wear today.
What size shoes do you wear?

穿.zh: 虽然外面很冷，但是他只穿了一件衬衫。
穿.en: Although it's cold outside, he only wore a shirt.

穿.zh: 她喜欢穿裙子，尤其是夏天。
穿.en: She likes to wear skirts, especially in summer.

学校.zh: 我们学校附近有家好吃的面馆。
学校.en: There is a good noodle shop near our school.
What time does your school finish?

学校.zh: 因为学校放假，所以我们可以出去玩。
学校.en: Because school is on holiday, we can go out and play.

学校.zh: 他在学校学习很努力，成绩很好。
学校.en: He studies very hard at school and gets good grades.

坐.en: I take the subway to work every day.
Do you take the plane or the train?

坐.zh: 如果你累了，就坐一会儿吧。
坐.en: If you're tired, sit for a while.

坐.zh: 他们坐在公园的长椅上聊天。
坐.en: They sat on the park bench chatting.

早.en: What time do you get up tomorrow morning?
He comes very early every day.

早.zh: 虽然现在还很早，但是我已经醒了。
早.en: Although it's still very early, I'm already awake.
Early to bed and early to rise makes a person healthy.

们.zh: 他们是我们班的新同学。
们.en: They are new classmates in our class.

们.zh: 我和朋友们一起去逛街。
们.en: My friends and I go shopping together.
The children are playing in the park.

身上.en: I have no money on me.

身上.zh: 他身上穿着那件蓝色T恤。
身上.en: He is wearing that blue T-shirt.
Do you have a tissue on you?

身上.zh: 因为他身上很脏，所以先去洗个澡。
身上.en: Because he is dirty, he goes to take a shower first.
She is wearing a lot of jewelry.

认识.en: We've known each other for a long time.

认识.zh: 虽然我们认识，但是不太熟。
认识.en: Although we know each other, we are not very familiar.

睡.en: He slept very well last night.
What time do you go to sleep?

睡.zh: 因为太吵了，所以我睡不着。
睡.en: Because it's too noisy, I can't fall asleep.
Taking a nap is good for your health.

分钟.en: I run for thirty minutes every day.

分钟.zh: 虽然只过了两分钟，但我觉得很久。
分钟.en: Although only two minutes passed, I felt it was a long time.

分钟.zh: 再给我一分钟，我马上就好。
分钟.en: Give me one more minute, I'll be ready soon.

明天.en: I'm going to the supermarket tomorrow.

明天.zh: 明天是周末，你可以睡懒觉。
明天.en: Tomorrow is the weekend, you can sleep in.

明天.zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去爬山。
明天.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go hiking.

明天.zh: 他说明天下午三点开会。
明天.en: He said the meeting is at 3 PM tomorrow.

四.zh: 一周有七天，周四我最忙。
四.en: There are seven days in a week, and Thursday is my busiest day.

四.zh: 他买了四个苹果和两瓶水。
四.en: He bought four apples and two bottles of water.

块.en: This piece of cake is really delicious.
It's three fifty (three yuan and five jiao) in total.
There is a stone on the ground.

块.zh: 他给了我一块手表当礼物。
块.en: He gave me a watch as a gift.

块.zh: 我把那块肉切成小块了。
块.en: I cut that piece of meat into small pieces.

外.en: He is waiting for me outside the door.

外.zh: 除了我以外，大家都去了。
这件外套放在外面会脏。
外.en: This coat will get dirty if left outside.
The company opened a branch in another city.

晚上.en: I don't eat dinner in the evening.
Let's meet at 7 PM in the evening.

晚上.zh: 因为晚上太吵，我睡不着。
晚上.en: Because it's too noisy at night, I can't sleep.

晚上.zh: 他喜欢晚上散步，觉得空气好。
晚上.en: He likes to take walks in the evening, thinking the air is good.

妈.en: My mom's cooking is the best.

妈.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我每周都去看我妈。
妈.en: Although work is busy, I visit my mom every week.

谢谢.en: Thank you for treating me to dinner.
Thanks to you this time, thank you!

学.zh: 弟弟学游泳学了三个月。
学.en: My younger brother learned swimming for three months.

学.zh: 一边工作一边学英语不容易。
学.en: It's not easy to learn English while working.

多少.en: How many people are in your family?
How much is this piece of clothing?

多少.zh: 你知道他有多少本书吗？
多少.en: Do you know how many books he has?

多少.zh: 不管有多少困难，我都不会放弃。
多少.en: No matter how many difficulties, I won't give up.

第二.en: I got second place in this competition.

第二.zh: 他是我们班第二高的同学。
第二.en: He is the second tallest student in our class.

第二.zh: 第二道菜是鱼，但是我不太喜欢吃。
第二.en: The second dish is fish, but I don't really like it.

第二.zh: 你考了第二，已经很不错了。
第二.en: You got second place, that's already pretty good.

第二.zh: 我先去超市，然后去第二家书店买书。
第二.en: I'll go to the supermarket first, then to the second bookstore to buy books.

妈妈.en: The food my mom cooks is the best.

妈妈.zh: 我妈妈今天工作很忙，所以没时间做饭。
妈妈.en: My mom is very busy at work today, so she has no time to cook.

妈妈.zh: 妈妈，你能帮我买一本书吗？
妈妈.en: Mom, can you help me buy a book?

妈妈.zh: 虽然妈妈很累，但她还是陪我玩游戏。
妈妈.en: Although mom is very tired, she still played games with me.

少.en: There are very few people today.
Say a few less words, okay?
Eat less sugar, it's good for your teeth.

少.zh: 这个月我花钱比较少，因为没什么要买的。
少.en: I spent less money this month because there's nothing I need to buy.

少.zh: 少玩游戏，多看书，这样学习才会好。
少.en: Play fewer games and read more books, then your studies will improve.

电影.zh: 你喜欢看什么类型的电影？
电影.en: What type of movies do you like to watch?

电影.zh: 昨天我和朋友一起看了一部恐怖电影。
电影.en: Yesterday I watched a horror movie with a friend.

电影.zh: 因为电影票太贵，所以我们没去看。
电影.en: Because the movie tickets were too expensive, we didn't go see it.

哪.en: Which restaurant do you want to eat at?

哪.zh: 我不知道哪条路最近，但是我可以查一下。
哪.en: I don't know which road is the shortest, but I can check.

哪.zh: 哪件衣服更好看，红色还是蓝色？
哪.en: Which piece of clothing looks better, the red one or the blue one?

回家.en: After work I went straight home.

回家.zh: 因为下雨了，所以我早点回家。
回家.en: Because it started raining, I went home earlier.

回家.zh: 回家以后，我先写作业再看电视。
回家.en: After I get home, I'll do my homework first and then watch TV.

昨天.en: I went to the park yesterday.

昨天.zh: 昨天你为什么不接电话？
昨天.en: Why didn't you answer the phone yesterday?

昨天.zh: 昨天我买了一本书，但是还没看。
昨天.en: Yesterday I bought a book, but I haven't read it yet.

昨天.zh: 昨天天气很好，所以我们去海边玩了。
昨天.en: The weather was nice yesterday, so we went to the beach to have fun.

晚.en: You went to bed too late.

晚.zh: 我今晚要加班，所以会晚回家。
晚.en: I have to work overtime tonight, so I'll come home late.

晚.zh: 晚一点我们再去吃饭吧。
晚.en: Let's go eat a little later.

晚.zh: 如果你晚到，记得给我打个电话。
晚.en: If you arrive late, remember to give me a call.

书.zh: 图书馆里有很多书，但是我没有借到想要的。
书.en: There are many books in the library, but I didn't borrow the one I wanted.

书.zh: 我每天睡前都会看一会儿书。
书.en: Every day before bed I read a book for a while.

五.zh: 我们五个人一起去吃饭。
五.en: The five of us went to eat together.

五.zh: 这个苹果五块钱一斤，买了两个。
五.en: These apples are five yuan per jin, I bought two.

五.zh: 他五岁就开始学钢琴了，现在弹得很好。
五.en: He started learning piano at age five, and now he plays very well.

先生.en: Sir, would you like some coffee?

先生.zh: 我先生今天去公司了，不在家。
先生.en: My husband went to the company today, he's not home.

先生.zh: 这位先生是大学教授吗？
先生.en: Is this gentleman a university professor?

先生.zh: 因为先生不在，所以我自己做饭了。
先生.en: Because my husband wasn't home, I cooked myself.

先生.zh: 你好，先生，请问几点开门？
先生.en: Hello, sir, may I ask what time you open?

男.zh: 我们公司男员工比女员工多。
男.en: Our company has more male employees than female ones.

男.zh: 男生和女生都参加了比赛。
男.en: Both male and female students participated in the competition.

男.zh: 虽然他是男的，但做饭很好吃。
男.en: Although he is male, his cooking is delicious.
The men's restroom is over here.

卖.en: That old man sells flowers on the street.

卖.zh: 这家店卖的衣服很便宜。
卖.en: The clothes sold in this store are very cheap.

卖.zh: 因为天气太热，冰棍卖得很快。
卖.en: Because the weather is too hot, popsicles sell very fast.
You sold this old book, right?

医院.zh: 我朋友在医院工作，是个护士。
医院.en: My friend works at a hospital, she is a nurse.
There is a pharmacy next to the hospital.

医院.zh: 如果你不舒服，就去医院看看。
医院.en: If you don't feel well, go to the hospital and get checked.
The service at this hospital is very good.

些.en: Those apples are not very fresh.

些.zh: 我有一些朋友，但都不在这里。
些.en: I have some friends, but none of them are here.
Can you talk a little less?

狗.zh: 那只小狗很可爱，我很喜欢。
狗.en: That little dog is very cute, I like it a lot.

狗.zh: 虽然狗很吵，但我还是爱它。
狗.en: Although the dog is noisy, I still love it.

真的.zh: 这件事是真的，我不骗你。
真的.en: This matter is true, I'm not lying to you.

真的.zh: 如果你真的想去，我就陪你。
真的.en: If you really want to go, I'll go with you.
What he said is not true.

口.zh: 请张开你的口，让我看看。
口.en: Please open your mouth, let me have a look.

口.zh: 因为口渴，我喝了一口水。
口.en: Because I was thirsty, I took a sip of water.

学生.zh: 虽然他是学生，但已经工作了。
学生.en: Although he is a student, he already works.

学生.zh: 这些大学生在街上做调查。
学生.en: These college students are doing a survey on the street.

二.zh: 要么你去，要么我去，二选一。
二.en: Either you go or I go, choose one of the two.

儿子.en: My son is five years old this year.
Her son really likes playing soccer.

儿子.zh: 我儿子和女儿都在上学。
儿子.en: My son and daughter are both in school.

儿子.zh: 他的儿子很聪明，但是不太努力。
儿子.en: His son is very smart, but not very hardworking.

儿子.zh: 昨天我儿子帮我洗了碗。
儿子.en: Yesterday my son helped me wash the dishes.

杯.en: Please give me a glass of water.

杯.zh: 我要一杯咖啡，再加点糖。
杯.en: I want a cup of coffee, plus some sugar.
He uses that cup to drink tea.

杯.zh: 杯子打碎了，但是没人受伤。
杯.en: The cup broke, but no one was hurt.

歌.en: I like listening to Chinese songs.
I am very familiar with this song.
He listens to songs while cooking.
Let's go to KTV and sing songs together.

半.en: I ate half a bowl of rice.
It's only half past seven now.
This apple is only half left.

半.zh: 他等了半个小时，然后走了。
半.en: He waited for half an hour, then left.

半.zh: 我花了半天时间才做完。
半.en: It took me half a day to finish.

中国.en: She wants to travel to China.
The Chinese New Year is very lively.

中国.zh: 我在中国住了三年，很喜欢那里。
中国.en: I lived in China for three years and really liked it there.

店.en: There is a fruit shop downstairs.
I bought a book at the bookstore.

店.zh: 这个店的东西便宜，而且质量好。
店.en: Things in this store are cheap and also good quality.

元.en: Apples are three yuan per catty.
He gave me one hundred yuan.

元.zh: 这个包要两百元，但是太贵了。
元.en: This bag costs two hundred yuan, but it's too expensive.

哪里.zh: 我不知道他把钥匙放哪里了。
哪里.en: I don't know where he put the keys.
Excuse me, where is the restroom?

那里.en: There is a coffee shop over there.
He has lived there for a long time.
It's very quiet there, suitable for studying.

那里.zh: 我们去那里吃饭吧，因为菜不错。
那里.en: Let's go eat there, because the food is good.

电视.en: This TV show is very interesting.

电视.zh: 我买了一个新电视，但是还没装好。
电视.en: I bought a new TV, but it's not set up yet.

下午.en: I'm going to the supermarket to buy things this afternoon.

下午.zh: 下午三点我们开会，你别迟到。
下午.en: We have a meeting at 3 p.m., don't be late.

下午.zh: 今天下午天气很热，我不想出去。
下午.en: It's very hot this afternoon, I don't want to go out.

下午.zh: 我下午先做作业，然后和朋友打球。
下午.en: I'll do my homework first this afternoon and then play ball with friends.

学习.en: How do you plan to learn Chinese?

学习.zh: 我喜欢学习新的东西，比如做饭。
学习.en: I like learning new things, like cooking.

学习.zh: 学习一门外语需要时间和耐心。
学习.en: Learning a foreign language takes time and patience.

学习.zh: 她每天学习三个小时，周末也不休息。
学习.en: She studies three hours every day, and she doesn't rest on weekends either.

它们.zh: 这些苹果很新鲜，你可以吃它们。
它们.en: These apples are very fresh, you can eat them.

它们.zh: 我的猫很可爱，它们喜欢玩球。
它们.en: My cats are very cute, they like to play with balls.

它们.zh: 那些书太重了，我不想搬它们。
它们.en: Those books are too heavy, I don't want to move them.

它们.zh: 我喜欢这些花，它们的颜色很漂亮。
它们.en: I like these flowers, their colors are very beautiful.

它们.zh: 小狗和小猫都很小，它们需要好好照顾。
它们.en: The puppy and the kitten are both very small, they need good care.

老师.zh: 我的老师姓王，她教数学。
老师.en: My teacher's surname is Wang, she teaches math.

老师.zh: 老师问了一个问题，没人回答。
老师.en: The teacher asked a question, but no one answered.

老师.zh: 这位老师对学生很有耐心。
老师.en: This teacher is very patient with students.

老师.zh: 如果你不懂，可以问老师，他会帮你。
老师.en: If you don't understand, you can ask the teacher, and he will help you.

六.en: He is six years old and just started elementary school.

六.zh: 我们六个人一起去吃饭吧。
六.en: Let's go eat together, the six of us.

六.zh: 一周有七天，我六天都要上班。
六.en: There are seven days in a week, and I have to work six days.

边.en: There are many people fishing by the river.
He listens to music while walking.

边.zh: 左边是银行，右边是超市。
边.en: On the left is the bank, on the right is the supermarket.
Don't stand by the roadside, it's too dangerous.

唱.en: Let's go sing at KTV together.

唱.zh: 他唱得非常好听，大家都鼓掌了。
唱.en: He sang very beautifully, and everyone applauded.

唱.zh: 孩子一边洗澡一边唱歌。
唱.en: The child sings while taking a bath.

大学.zh: 我大学学的是经济专业。
去年他从大学毕业，现在工作了。
大学.en: He graduated from university last year and now works.

大学.zh: 大学里有很多社团活动，你可以参加。
大学.en: There are many club activities in university; you can join them.

病.zh: 这个病不严重，休息几天就好。
病.en: This illness is not serious; rest a few days and you'll be fine.

病.zh: 她得了重病，一直在住院。
病.en: She has a serious illness and has been hospitalized.

病.zh: 多喝水可以预防感冒这种病。
病.en: Drinking more water can prevent diseases like the common cold.

病.zh: 我昨天没上班，因为病了。
病.en: I didn't go to work yesterday because I was sick.

医生.zh: 这位医生很专业，态度也好。
医生.en: This doctor is very professional and has a good attitude.

医生.zh: 我明天要去看医生，检查一下身体。
医生.en: I'm going to see the doctor tomorrow for a check-up.

医生.zh: 医生告诉我多休息，别熬夜。
医生.en: The doctor told me to rest more and not stay up late.

名字.zh: 这个名字听起来很熟悉。
请把你的名字写在这里。
虽然我记不住他的名字，但是我知道他住在哪儿。
名字.en: Although I can't remember his name, I know where he lives.

她们.en: They all like to eat hotpot.

她们.zh: 我昨天看见她们在公园里玩。
她们.en: I saw them playing in the park yesterday.

她们.zh: 因为她们很努力，所以考试都通过了。
她们.en: Because they worked hard, they all passed the exam.

她们.zh: 她们三个人一起去了上海旅行。
她们.en: The three of them went to Shanghai together for a trip.

今年.en: I am twenty years old this year.
What are your plans this year?

今年.zh: 今年夏天我们打算去海边。
今年.en: This summer we plan to go to the beach.

今年.zh: 今年比去年热多了，而且雨水也少。
今年.en: This year is much hotter than last year, and there is less rain.

手机.en: My phone is out of battery.
The phone is on the table.
She watches videos on her phone every day.

手机.zh: 别一边走路一边玩手机。
手机.en: Don't play with your phone while walking.

手机.zh: 虽然手机很方便，但是也会让人分心。
手机.en: Although phones are convenient, they can also be distracting.

忙.en: He is too busy to eat.

忙.zh: 最近公司特别忙，周末也要加班。
忙.en: The company has been especially busy lately, and we have to work overtime on weekends.

忙.zh: 虽然我很忙，但是还是抽空去锻炼了。
忙.en: Even though I was busy, I still made time to exercise.

十.en: He goes to bed at ten every day.

十.zh: 从十到二十，我都喜欢这些数字。
十.en: From ten to twenty, I like all these numbers.

看见.zh: 我从来没看见过这样的东西。
看见.en: I have never seen such a thing.

看见.zh: 在街上我看见一个老朋友。
看见.en: On the street I saw an old friend.

看见.zh: 因为天太黑，我没看见路边的石头。
看见.en: Because it was too dark, I didn't see the stone on the roadside.

听到.en: Did you hear what I said?

听到.zh: 她听到这个消息很高兴。
听到.en: She was very happy to hear the news.

听到.zh: 我在外面听到有人在唱歌。
虽然我听到了，但是没听清楚。
听到.en: Although I heard it, I didn't hear it clearly.

女儿.en: My daughter is three years old.
My daughter doesn't have school today.

女儿.zh: 昨天我跟女儿一起做了蛋糕。
女儿.en: Yesterday I made a cake with my daughter.

说话.zh: 我不喜欢跟陌生人说话。
说话.en: I don't like talking to strangers.

说话.zh: 因为他在说话，所以没听到铃声。
说话.en: Because he was talking, he didn't hear the ringtone.

爸爸.zh: 我爸爸每天六点起床去上班。
爸爸.en: My dad gets up at six every day to go to work.

爸爸.zh: 虽然爸爸很忙，但他总是陪我玩。
爸爸.en: Although Dad is very busy, he always plays with me.
The food Dad cooks is especially delicious.

爸爸.zh: 昨天爸爸给我买了一辆自行车。
爸爸.en: Yesterday Dad bought me a bicycle.

字.en: How do you write this character?

字.zh: 我每天写一百个汉字，进步很快。
字.en: I write a hundred Chinese characters every day, and I improve quickly.

字.zh: 因为不认识那个字，所以我查了字典。
字.en: Because I didn't know that character, I looked it up in the dictionary.

字.zh: 这个字太复杂了，我记不住。
字.en: This character is too complicated, I can't remember it.

漂亮.zh: 这件衣服又漂亮又便宜，我买了。
漂亮.en: This dress is both pretty and cheap, so I bought it.

漂亮.zh: 虽然她不漂亮，但是很善良。
漂亮.en: Although she is not pretty, she is very kind.

漂亮.zh: 那个花园里的花非常漂亮。
漂亮.en: The flowers in that garden are very beautiful.

高兴.zh: 收到你的礼物，我高兴得跳了起来。
高兴.en: Receiving your gift, I jumped with joy.

高兴.zh: 如果明天不下雨，我就高兴了。
高兴.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, I'll be happy.

高兴.zh: 听到这个消息，她高兴地哭了。
高兴.en: Hearing the news, she cried with joy.

去年.en: Last year I went to Beijing.

去年.zh: 去年冬天特别冷，我每天都穿羽绒服。
去年.en: Last winter was very cold, I wore a down jacket every day.

去年.zh: 因为去年工作太忙，所以没有休假。
去年.en: Because I was too busy working last year, I didn't take a vacation.

去年.zh: 去年她学会了很多中文。
去年.en: She learned a lot of Chinese last year.

去年.zh: 去年这个时候我们还在上学呢。
去年.en: At this time last year, we were still in school.

热.zh: 夏天天气很热，我每天都想喝冰水。
热.en: Summer weather is very hot, I want to drink ice water every day.

热.zh: 虽然天气很热，但他还是去跑步了。
热.en: Although it's very hot, he still went running.

热.zh: 这杯水还热着呢，你等一下再喝。
热.en: This cup of water is still hot, wait a moment before drinking.
When it's hot, I turn on the air conditioner.

来到.zh: 昨天一位新同学来到我们班，大家都很欢迎。
来到.en: Yesterday a new student came to our class, everyone welcomed him.

来到.zh: 当我来到城市时，发现一切都那么新鲜。
来到.en: When I came to the city, I found everything so new.

来到.zh: 春天来到的时候，花儿都开了。
来到.en: When spring arrives, the flowers all bloom.

来到.zh: 客人来到我家，我给他们倒茶。
来到.en: When guests come to my home, I pour them tea.

睡觉.zh: 每天晚上十点，我就上床睡觉。
睡觉.en: Every night at ten, I go to bed to sleep.

睡觉.zh: 因为明天要早起，所以我今晚早点儿睡觉。
睡觉.en: Because I have to get up early tomorrow, I'll go to sleep early tonight.

睡觉.zh: 他睡觉的时候喜欢听音乐。
睡觉.en: He likes to listen to music when he sleeps.

睡觉.zh: 昨晚我睡觉很晚，今天很困。
睡觉.en: Last night I slept very late, so I'm very sleepy today.

电脑.zh: 这台电脑用了三年，速度越来越慢了。
电脑.en: This computer has been used for three years, and its speed is getting slower.

电脑.zh: 如果你不会用电脑，可以问老师。
电脑.en: If you don't know how to use a computer, you can ask the teacher.

电脑.zh: 他整天都在玩电脑游戏。
电脑.en: He plays computer games all day.

电脑.zh: 我用电脑写作业，很方便。
电脑.en: I use a computer to do my homework, it's very convenient.

第.zh: 这是我第二次来上海，感觉变化很大。
第.en: This is my second time coming to Shanghai, I feel it has changed a lot.

第.zh: 不管你是第几次来，都会喜欢这里。
第.en: No matter how many times you come, you will like it here.
I am ranked tenth in the class.
The third class is physical education.

回到.zh: 他回到家里以后就开始做饭。
回到.en: After he returned home, he started cooking.
When do you return to Beijing?

回到.zh: 因为下雨，我们只好回到教室。
回到.en: Because it rained, we had to go back to the classroom.
Returning to the past is impossible.

家里.zh: 我家里有三只猫和一只狗。
家里.en: There are three cats and one dog in my home.

家里.zh: 虽然家里很乱，但是我很喜欢待着。
家里.en: Although home is messy, I like staying there.

家里.zh: 我周末一般都在家里休息。
家里.en: I usually rest at home on weekends.

读.zh: 他每天读一个小时的中文。
读.en: He reads Chinese for an hour every day.

读.zh: 如果你读完了，就告诉我。
读.en: If you finish reading, tell me.

冷.zh: 冬天的时候这里特别冷。
冷.en: It's especially cold here in winter.

冷.zh: 因为天气冷，我穿了很多衣服。
冷.en: Because the weather is cold, I wore a lot of clothes.
This glass of water is too cold.

飞机.en: I take a plane to Shanghai for a business trip.

飞机.zh: 如果飞机晚点，我们就改签。
飞机.en: If the plane is delayed, we will change the ticket.
You cannot make phone calls on the plane.

飞机.zh: 你第一次坐飞机是什么时候？
飞机.en: When was your first time on a plane?

早上.en: I get up at six every morning.

早上.zh: 因为早上起晚了，我迟到了。
早上.en: Because I woke up late in the morning, I was late.
What do you eat in the morning?

早上.zh: 明天早上我们一起去跑步吧。
早上.en: Let's go running together tomorrow morning.

哥.en: My older brother is three years older than me.

哥.zh: 虽然我哥很忙，但他经常帮我。
哥.en: Although my brother is busy, he often helps me.
My older brother likes playing basketball.

爸.en: My dad works very hard every day.

爸.zh: 因为爸生病了，所以没去上班。
爸.en: Because dad is sick, he didn't go to work.
What does your dad do for work?

猫.zh: 我家的猫特别喜欢吃鱼。
猫.en: My family's cat really likes eating fish.

猫.zh: 虽然猫很小，但是很聪明。
猫.en: Although the cat is very small, it is very smart.

打电话.en: I am making a phone call.

打电话.zh: 他每天晚上给妈妈打电话。
打电话.en: He calls his mother every evening.

打电话.zh: 如果你需要帮助，就给我打电话。
打电话.en: If you need help, call me.

打电话.zh: 我正在打电话，等会儿再说。
打电话.en: I'm on the phone, talk later.
You can make calls with a mobile phone.

休息.zh: 你累了吗？休息一会儿吧。
休息.en: Are you tired? Have a rest for a while.

休息.zh: 今天工作太多了，我需要好好休息。
休息.en: I have too much work today, I need to rest well.

休息.zh: 他休息了十分钟，然后继续跑步。
休息.en: He rested for ten minutes, then continued running.

休息.zh: 如果你不舒服，就多休息，别太累了。
休息.en: If you don't feel well, rest more and don't get too tired.

有的.zh: 有的人喜欢猫，有的人喜欢狗。
有的.en: Some people like cats, some people like dogs.

有的.zh: 这些书有的很旧，有的很新。
有的.en: Some of these books are very old, some are very new.

有的.zh: 我们班里有的同学会说法语。
有的.en: Some classmates in our class can speak French.

有的.zh: 周末有的地方人多，有的地方人少。
有的.en: On weekends, some places are crowded, some are not.

喂.en: Hey, don't go, I have something to tell you.

房间.en: Have you tidied up your room?

房间.zh: 酒店的房间有空调和电视。
房间.en: The hotel room has air conditioning and a TV.

房间.zh: 我租了一个小房间，租金不贵。
房间.en: I rented a small room, the rent is not expensive.

房间.zh: 因为房间太吵，我晚上没睡好。
房间.en: Because the room was too noisy, I didn't sleep well at night.

八.en: Let's meet at half past eight.

八.zh: 他买了八个苹果，分给朋友们吃。
八.en: He bought eight apples and shared them with friends.

怎么样.zh: 你觉得这个主意怎么样？
怎么样.en: What do you think of this idea?
How about we go see a movie?

怎么样.zh: 你第一次来中国，感觉怎么样？
怎么样.en: You came to China for the first time, how do you feel?

吃饭.en: He eats at twelve o'clock every day.

吃饭.zh: 因为太忙，他常常忘记吃饭。
吃饭.en: Because he is too busy, he often forgets to eat.

七.en: There are seven days in a week.
He lives on the seventh floor.

菜.en: I'm going to buy groceries, wait for me.
There are many kinds of dishes on the menu.
I like the dishes my mom cooks the most.

菜.zh: 今天点的菜太辣了，我吃不了。
菜.en: The dish I ordered today is too spicy, I can't eat it.

衣服.en: This piece of clothing is very pretty.
Your clothes are dirty, go change quickly.

衣服.zh: 我在网上买了几件新衣服。
衣服.en: I bought some new clothes online.

衣服.zh: 洗衣服的时候记得把口袋里的东西拿出来。
衣服.en: Remember to take things out of pockets when washing clothes.

衣服.zh: 因为天气变冷了，他穿上了厚衣服。
衣服.en: Because the weather got cold, he put on thick clothes.

上班.en: I go to work at eight every day.
Are you going to work today?

上班.zh: 他上班路上堵车了，所以迟到了。
上班.en: He was stuck in traffic on the way to work, so he was late.

上班.zh: 我不喜欢上班，但没办法。
上班.en: I don't like going to work, but I have no choice.

上班.zh: 她刚找到一份新工作，下周一开始上班。
上班.en: She just found a new job and will start work next Monday.

姐姐.en: My older sister is two years older than me.

姐姐.zh: 姐姐，你帮我看看这道题好吗？
姐姐.en: Sister, can you help me look at this problem?

姐姐.zh: 虽然姐姐很忙，但她还是常常帮我。
姐姐.en: Although my sister is very busy, she still often helps me.

姐姐.zh: 她姐姐在银行工作，很忙。
姐姐.en: Her sister works at a bank and is very busy.

姐姐.zh: 我姐姐特别喜欢做饭，周末常做蛋糕。
姐姐.en: My sister really likes cooking and often makes cakes on weekends.

课.en: There's an English class this afternoon.

课.zh: 上节课学的内容你记住了吗？
课.en: Did you remember what we learned in last class?
He didn't go to class because he had a cold.

课.zh: 这节课老师讲了很多语法点，我得复习一下。
课.en: In this class the teacher covered many grammar points, so I need to review.

课.zh: 你喜欢上什么课？我喜欢体育课。
课.en: What class do you like? I like PE.

国.zh: 中国是一个很大的国家。
国.en: China is a very big country.
Which countries have you been to?

国.zh: 他出生在一个小国，但后来移民了。
国.en: He was born in a small country but later immigrated.

国.zh: 每个国家都有自己的文化和节日。
国.en: Every country has its own culture and holidays.

饭.en: Mom's cooking is the most delicious.

饭.zh: 我们一起去外面吃饭吧，我请客。
饭.en: Let's go out to eat together, it's my treat.

饭.zh: 因为妈妈做的饭很好吃，所以我很少点外卖。
饭.en: Because mom's cooking is delicious, I rarely order takeout.

一半.zh: 一半的同学都选了这堂课。
一半.en: Half of the students chose this class.

一半.zh: 这件事我只做了一半，还需要你帮忙。
一半.en: I only did half of this task, I still need your help.

一半.zh: 她看了一半的电影就睡着了，因为太累了。
一半.en: She fell asleep halfway through the movie because she was too tired.

家人.en: My family all live in Beijing.

家人.zh: 你家人支持你学中文吗？
家人.en: Does your family support you learning Chinese?

家人.zh: 周末我一般和家人一起吃饭。
家人.en: On weekends I usually eat with my family.

家人.zh: 她的家人对我特别热情，让我感觉很温暖。
家人.en: Her family is especially warm to me, making me feel very welcomed.

家人.zh: 虽然家人不在身边，但我会经常打电话。
家人.en: Although my family is not around, I call them often.

对不起.zh: 对不起，我不小心把杯子打碎了。
对不起.en: Sorry, I accidentally broke the cup.

对不起.zh: 这件事是我做错了，对不起。
对不起.en: I was wrong about this, sorry.

对不起.zh: 对不起，刚才没听清你说的话，能再说一遍吗？
对不起.en: Sorry, I didn't hear what you said just now, could you repeat it?

对不起.zh: 他跟我说了对不起，但我还是有点生气。
对不起.en: He said sorry to me, but I'm still a bit angry.

哥哥.en: My older brother is a doctor.

哥哥.zh: 哥哥，你能帮我修一下电脑吗？
哥哥.en: Brother, can you help me fix the computer?
His older brother is much taller than him.

哥哥.zh: 我哥哥喜欢打篮球，每个周末都去打球。
哥哥.en: My brother likes playing basketball and goes to play every weekend.

哥哥.zh: 因为哥哥会修电脑，所以我常常找他帮忙。
哥哥.en: Because my brother knows how to fix computers, I often ask him for help.

没什么.en: It's nothing, no need to thank me.

没什么.zh: A: 你怎么了？B: 没什么，就是有点累。
没什么.en: A: What's wrong? B: Nothing, just a bit tired.

没什么.zh: 这没什么大不了的，别担心。
没什么.en: It's no big deal, don't worry.

没什么.zh: 他问我为什么生气，我说没什么。
没什么.en: He asked me why I was angry, I said nothing.

没什么.zh: 其实没什么好怕的，勇敢一点就行。
没什么.en: Actually, there's nothing to be afraid of, just be brave.

天气.zh: 因为天气太热，我们不想出去。
天气.en: Because the weather is too hot, we don't want to go out.

天气.zh: 天气变冷了，你要多穿衣服。
天气.en: The weather has turned cold, you should wear more clothes.

天气.zh: 虽然天气预报说会下雨，但是我还是想出门。
天气.en: Although the weather forecast says it will rain, I still want to go out.

有时候.zh: 他有时候很忙，有时候很闲。
有时候.en: He is sometimes very busy, sometimes very free.

有时候.zh: 有时候，我们需要一个人静一静。
有时候.en: Sometimes we need some time alone.

有时候.zh: 虽然我经常跑步，但有时候也会偷懒。
有时候.en: Although I often run, sometimes I also slack off.

千.en: This bag is one thousand yuan.

千.zh: 他每个月能赚几千块钱。
千.en: He can earn several thousand yuan a month.

千.zh: 千山万水，我们终于见面了。
千.en: Through thousands of mountains and rivers, we finally met.

千.zh: 那家餐厅一天能做上千份外卖。
千.en: That restaurant can make over a thousand takeout orders a day.

同学.zh: 我和同学一起去图书馆学习。
同学.en: I went to the library to study with my classmates.

同学.zh: 我小学同学现在在别的城市工作。
同学.en: My elementary school classmate now works in another city.
Old classmate, long time no see!

好看.en: This piece of clothing is really pretty.

好看.zh: 她长得好看，而且性格也很好。
好看.en: She is good-looking, and her personality is also nice.

好看.zh: 这部电影很好看，推荐你看。
好看.en: This movie is very good, I recommend you watch it.

好看.zh: 虽然这个花瓶很好看，但是太贵了。
好看.en: Although this vase is beautiful, it's too expensive.
You look good when you smile.

茶.zh: 我每天下午都会喝一杯绿茶。
茶.en: I have a cup of green tea every afternoon.
The tea at this shop is very tasty.

茶.zh: 他给我倒了一杯茶，然后我们开始聊天。
茶.en: He poured me a cup of tea, and then we started chatting.

茶.zh: 茶凉了，我再给你倒一杯。
茶.en: The tea has gone cold, I'll pour you another cup.

雨.zh: 因为下大雨，所以比赛取消了。
雨.en: Because of heavy rain, the game was canceled.
After the rain, the air is especially fresh.

雨.zh: 我最喜欢下雨天在家睡觉。
雨.en: I like sleeping at home on rainy days the most.

星期.en: Next week I have to go on a business trip.

星期.zh: 我每个星期一都要开早会。
星期.en: I have a morning meeting every Monday.
Which day of the week are you free?

雪.zh: 今年的雪比去年大很多。
雪.en: This year's snow is much heavier than last year's.

雪.zh: 雪停了，我们去堆雪人吧。
雪.en: The snow stopped, let's go make a snowman.

雪.zh: 因为雪太大，学校今天放假了。
雪.en: Because the snow is too heavy, school is off today.

车上.en: There are many people on the bus.

车上.zh: 我在车上睡着了，坐过了站。
车上.en: I fell asleep on the bus and missed my stop.

车上.zh: 因为车上太挤，我只好站着。
车上.en: Because it was too crowded on the bus, I had to stand.
He played music in his car.

九.en: I go to sleep at nine.

九.zh: 我们九个人一起去吃饭。
九.en: The nine of us went to eat together.

九.zh: 现在是九点十五分，你迟到了。
如果你九点还没到，我就先走了。
九.en: If you haven't arrived by nine, I'll leave first.

妹妹.en: My younger sister is very cute.
My younger sister is reading in her room.

妹妹.zh: 我妹妹总是跟我抢电视。
妹妹.en: My younger sister always fights me for the TV.

妹妹.zh: 因为妹妹生病了，所以今天没去上学。
妹妹.en: Because my younger sister is sick, she didn't go to school today.

妹妹.zh: 妹妹喜欢吃冰淇淋，但是妈妈不让。
妹妹.en: My younger sister likes to eat ice cream, but mom won't let her.

女士.zh: 那位穿红裙子的女士是我老师。
女士.en: That lady in the red dress is my teacher.

女士.zh: 女士们，先生们，欢迎参加晚会。
女士.en: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the party.

女士.zh: 如果女士您有空，请填一下表格。
女士.en: If you, ma'am, have time, please fill out this form.

地上.en: The book fell on the floor.
There are many fallen leaves on the ground.
Be careful, there's water on the floor, don't slip.

地上.zh: 他把垃圾扔在地上，这样不好。
地上.en: He threw trash on the ground, that's not good.

地上.zh: 地上湿了，因为刚刚下过雨。
地上.en: The ground is wet because it just rained.

上午.en: I'm going to the supermarket in the morning.

上午.zh: 我上午很忙，下午才有空。
上午.en: I'm very busy in the morning, I'll be free in the afternoon.

上午.zh: 因为上午下雨，所以我们没去公园。
上午.en: Because it rained in the morning, we didn't go to the park.

上午.zh: 如果你上午来，我们可以一起喝咖啡。
上午.en: If you come in the morning, we can have coffee together.

贵.en: The phone is very expensive, I can't afford it.

贵.zh: 这家餐厅的菜很贵但很好吃。
贵.en: The food at this restaurant is expensive but delicious.

贵.zh: 虽然这件衣服很贵，但是质量很好。
贵.en: Although this piece of clothing is expensive, the quality is very good.
Do you think this bag is expensive or not?

记住.en: You need to remember this address.

记住.zh: 记住，明天早上八点集合。
记住.en: Remember, we gather at 8 AM tomorrow.

记住.zh: 我记住你的话了，你放心。
记住.en: I remember what you said, don't worry.

下次.en: Remember to bring an umbrella next time.
I'll treat this time, you treat next time.

下次.zh: 如果你下次迟到，我就不等你了。
下次.en: If you're late next time, I won't wait for you.

下次.zh: 下次我们一起去旅行吧。
下次.en: Let's go traveling together next time.

那边.zh: 请往那边走，左转就到了。
那边.en: Please go that way, turn left and you'll arrive.

那边.zh: 那边人很多，我们别去了。
那边.en: There are a lot of people over there, let's not go.

那边.zh: 如果那边太远，我们可以坐车。
那边.en: If it's too far over there, we can take a car.

弟弟.en: My younger brother is six years old.
My younger brother likes to play soccer.
My younger brother is two years younger than me.

弟弟.zh: 弟弟在写作业，妈妈在做饭。
弟弟.en: My younger brother is doing homework, and mom is cooking.

弟弟.zh: 因为弟弟生病了，所以我陪他去医院。
弟弟.en: Because my younger brother is sick, I accompanied him to the hospital.

在家.zh: 我周末喜欢在家看书和听音乐。
在家.en: I like to read and listen to music at home on weekends.

在家.zh: 因为下雨，我们只能在家玩。
在家.en: Because it's raining, we can only play at home.

在家.zh: 他不在家，你晚上再打电话吧。
在家.en: He's not at home, call again in the evening.

百.en: This book is one hundred yuan.

百.zh: 他花了上百块钱买礼物。
百.en: He spent over a hundred yuan on gifts.

百.zh: 虽然很难，但我会百分之百努力。
百.en: Although it's hard, I will give one hundred percent effort.
There are hundreds of kinds of apples here.

好吃.zh: 妈妈做的菜比饭店的还好吃。
好吃.en: Mom's cooking is even more delicious than restaurant food.
What fruit is the most delicious?

好吃.zh: 这家店的饺子很好吃，我们经常来。
好吃.en: The dumplings at this shop are delicious, we often come here.

好吃.zh: 虽然看起来很普通，但是味道很好吃。
好吃.en: Although it looks ordinary, the taste is delicious.

明年.en: Next year I'm going to China.

明年.zh: 明年春天我们计划去旅行。
明年.en: Next spring we plan to travel.
How old will you be next year?

明年.zh: 如果明年有时间，我想学中文。
明年.en: If I have time next year, I want to learn Chinese.

明年.zh: 明年这个时候我就毕业了。
明年.en: At this time next year, I will have graduated.

再见.en: Goodbye, be careful on the road.

再见.zh: 跟老师说完再见就回家了。
再见.en: After saying goodbye to the teacher, I went home.
Goodbye, let's play together next time.

妹.en: My younger sister started elementary school this year.
Older sister and younger sister are both at home.
How many younger sisters do you have?

这儿.zh: 这儿的东西比那儿便宜。
这儿.en: Things here are cheaper than there.

这儿.zh: 你在这儿等一下，我去买水。
这儿.en: Wait here for a moment, I'll go buy water.

这儿.zh: 因为这儿太吵了，我们换个地方吧。
这儿.en: Because it's too noisy here, let's change place.

哪儿.zh: 你住在哪儿？我想去找你。
哪儿.en: Where do you live? I want to go find you.

哪儿.zh: 我忘了把手机放哪儿了。
哪儿.en: I forgot where I put my phone.

哪儿.zh: 无论你去哪儿，我都跟着你。
哪儿.en: Wherever you go, I'll follow you.

苹果.zh: 苹果对身体很好，要多吃。
苹果.en: Apples are good for health, eat more.

苹果.zh: 妈妈买了五斤苹果放在桌上。
苹果.en: Mom bought five jin of apples and put them on the table.

苹果.zh: 我最喜欢吃红色的苹果。
苹果.en: I like eating red apples the most.

不对.zh: 你说得不对，应该是这样。
不对.en: What you said is not right, it should be like this.
Oh no, I forgot to bring the key.

不对.zh: 如果不对的话，你再试一次。
不对.en: If it's not correct, try again.

中午.en: What are we eating for lunch?

中午.zh: 中午太热了，我不想出去。
中午.en: It's too hot at noon, I don't want to go out.
He usually takes a nap at noon.

中午.zh: 你中午有空吗？我们一起吃饭吧。
中午.en: Are you free at noon? Let's eat together.

中午.zh: 我中午才起床，所以没吃早饭。
中午.en: I didn't get up until noon, so I skipped breakfast.

起床.en: What time do you get up every day?
I get up at 7 in the morning.

起床.zh: 她起床以后先喝一杯水。
起床.en: After she gets up, she drinks a glass of water first.

起床.zh: 周末我通常很晚才起床。
起床.en: On weekends I usually get up very late.

是不是.zh: 这件衣服是不是太贵了？
你是不是明天要去北京，还是后天？
是不是.en: Are you going to Beijing tomorrow, or the day after?

开车.zh: 开车的时候不要打电话。
开车.en: Don't use the phone while driving.

开车.zh: 今天路上堵车，开车比坐地铁还慢。
开车.en: There was a traffic jam today, driving was even slower than taking the subway.

出租车.en: I want to take a taxi.
Taking a taxi is more expensive than taking the bus.

出租车.zh: 因为下雨了，我们只好坐出租车回家。
出租车.en: Because it was raining, we had to take a taxi home.

干什么.en: What did he go to do?
What do you want to do on the weekend?

干什么.zh: 他整天不干什么，就是玩手机。
干什么.en: He does nothing all day, just plays with his phone.

干什么.zh: 你叫我过来干什么？有什么事吗？
干什么.en: What did you call me over for? Is something the matter?

奶.zh: 早上喝一杯奶对身体好。
奶.en: Drinking a glass of milk in the morning is good for your health.

奶.zh: 这个奶茶太甜了，我不太喜欢。
奶.en: This milk tea is too sweet, I don't really like it.

这边.zh: 我觉得这边的东西更好吃。
这边.en: I think the food over here tastes better.

这边.zh: 你从这边走，然后右拐就到了。
这边.en: Go this way, then turn right and you'll be there.

火车.en: I take the train to Shanghai.
Have you bought the train ticket?
What time does this train arrive?

火车.zh: 因为飞机票太贵，所以我们决定坐火车去旅行。
火车.en: Because the plane tickets were too expensive, we decided to travel by train.

便宜.en: That one is cheaper than this one.

便宜.zh: 这里的水果又便宜又好吃。
便宜.en: The fruit here is cheap and delicious.

便宜.zh: 你买贵了，我买的更便宜。
便宜.en: You bought it too expensive, I bought it cheaper.

便宜.zh: 虽然这家店的东西便宜，但是质量不太好。
便宜.en: Although things in this store are cheap, the quality is not very good.

上次.zh: 上次我们去了哪家餐厅？
上次.en: Which restaurant did we go to last time?

上次.zh: 上次考试没考好，这次要努力。
上次.en: I didn't do well on the last exam; this time I have to work hard.

上次.zh: 上次见面还是去年冬天呢。
上次.en: Last time we met was last winter.

上次.zh: 上次你说要教我做饭，什么时候有空？
上次.en: Last time you said you'd teach me to cook; when are you free?

上次.zh: 上次的事真对不起，我以后会注意的。
上次.en: I'm really sorry about last time; I'll be more careful in the future.

唱歌.en: Let's go to KTV and sing together!

唱歌.zh: 他唱歌特别好听，像明星一样。
唱歌.en: He sings really well, like a star.

唱歌.zh: 昨天在派对上，大家都唱歌跳舞很开心。
唱歌.en: At the party yesterday, everyone sang and danced and had a great time.

唱歌.zh: 虽然我不太会唱歌，但和朋友一起玩很放松。
唱歌.en: Although I'm not very good at singing, it's relaxing to hang out with friends.

上学.en: What time does the child go to school?

上学.zh: 明天我不上学，因为要去看病。
上学.en: I'm not going to school tomorrow because I have a doctor's appointment.

上学.zh: 她每天骑自行车上学，很方便。
上学.en: She rides her bike to school every day; it's very convenient.

上学.zh: 小时候我总觉得上学很无聊。
上学.en: When I was little, I always thought going to school was boring.

上学.zh: 虽然下雨了，孩子们还是坚持走路去上学。
上学.en: Even though it was raining, the children still insisted on walking to school.

牛奶.zh: 早上喝一杯牛奶对身体好。
牛奶.en: Drinking a glass of milk in the morning is good for your health.

牛奶.zh: 牛奶快过期了，记得喝完。
牛奶.en: The milk is about to expire; remember to finish it.

牛奶.zh: 我不喜欢喝纯牛奶，太淡了。
牛奶.en: I don't like drinking plain milk; it's too bland.

牛奶.zh: 妈妈让我去超市买一盒牛奶。
牛奶.en: Mom asked me to go to the supermarket and buy a carton of milk.

牛奶.zh: 咖啡里加一点牛奶，味道更香。
牛奶.en: Adding a little milk to coffee makes it taste better.

女朋友.zh: 他给女朋友买了一条项链。
女朋友.en: He bought a necklace for his girlfriend.

女朋友.zh: 女朋友最近工作很忙，周末才能见面。
女朋友.en: My girlfriend has been very busy with work lately; we can only meet on weekends.

女朋友.zh: 虽然吵架了，但他还是去接女朋友下班。
女朋友.en: Even though they had a fight, he still went to pick up his girlfriend from work.

上课.zh: 今天上课老师讲了新语法。
上课.en: Today in class the teacher taught new grammar.

上课.zh: 他上课总是玩手机，不认真听。
上课.en: He always plays on his phone in class and doesn't listen carefully.

上课.zh: 因为堵车，我上课迟到了十分钟。
上课.en: I was ten minutes late for class because of a traffic jam.

上课.zh: 虽然上课很累，但他每天都准时到。
上课.en: Even though class is tiring, he arrives on time every day.

听见.en: I heard someone knocking on the door.

听见.zh: 你刚才听见我说的话了吗？
听见.en: Did you hear what I said just now?

听见.zh: 她在隔壁房间，能听见我们聊天。
听见.en: She's in the next room and can hear us chatting.

听见.zh: 声音太小了，我根本没听见。
听见.en: The sound was too low; I didn't hear it at all.

听见.zh: 虽然戴了耳机，我还是听见外面的雨声。
听见.en: Even though I was wearing headphones, I could still hear the rain outside.

男朋友.en: Her boyfriend is tall and handsome.
My boyfriend works at a bank.

男朋友.zh: 昨天男朋友送了我一束花。
男朋友.en: Yesterday my boyfriend gave me a bouquet of flowers.

男朋友.zh: 她和男朋友一起去看电影了。
男朋友.en: She went to watch a movie with her boyfriend.

男朋友.zh: 虽然男朋友很忙，但他每天都会打电话给我。
男朋友.en: Even though my boyfriend is very busy, he calls me every day.

下班.en: What time do you get off work?

下班.zh: 今天下班后我要去健身房。
下班.en: After work today, I'm going to the gym.

下班.zh: 他下班回家第一件事就是洗澡。
下班.en: The first thing he does when he gets home from work is take a shower.

下班.zh: 老板让我们加班，所以下班很晚。
下班.en: The boss made us work overtime, so we got off work very late.

下班.zh: 虽然很累，但下班后我们还是出去吃了火锅。
下班.en: Even though we were tired, we still went out for hotpot after work.

水果.en: Eating more fruit is good for your health.
This fruit is very sweet; have a taste.

水果.zh: 水果店里的苹果很新鲜。
水果.en: The apples at the fruit store are very fresh.

水果.zh: 夏天我喜欢吃西瓜和葡萄这些水果。
水果.en: In summer, I like to eat fruits like watermelon and grapes.

水果.zh: 虽然水果很贵，但为了健康还是要买。
水果.en: Even though fruit is expensive, you still have to buy it for your health.

读书.en: He reads for an hour every day.

读书.zh: 虽然很累，但我还是坚持读书。
读书.en: Although very tired, I still insist on reading.

读书.zh: 你读书的时候别玩手机。
读书.en: Don't play with your phone while reading.

读书.zh: 因为明天要考试，所以今晚我得好好读书。
读书.en: Because there's an exam tomorrow, I have to study hard tonight.

那儿.en: There is someone waiting for you over there.

那儿.zh: 我们先去那儿，然后去公园。
那儿.en: We'll go there first, then go to the park.

那儿.zh: 如果你想去那儿，我可以带路。
那儿.en: If you want to go there, I can lead the way.

商店.zh: 这家商店的东西很便宜。
商店.en: Things in this store are very cheap.
I bought two bottles of water at the store.

商店.zh: 因为下雨，商店里的人不多。
商店.en: Because it's raining, there aren't many people in the store.

商店.zh: 你帮我问问那家商店几点关门。
商店.en: Help me ask what time that store closes.

鸡蛋.en: There are no eggs in the fridge.
Eating eggs in the morning is good for health.
Mom made a cake with eggs.

鸡蛋.zh: 我喜欢吃炒鸡蛋，但是不喜欢煮鸡蛋。
鸡蛋.en: I like scrambled eggs, but I don't like boiled eggs.

没关系.en: It doesn't matter if you're late.

没关系.zh: 没做完没关系，明天再做。
没关系.en: It's okay if you didn't finish; do it tomorrow.
He apologized, and I said it's no problem.

没关系.zh: 虽然你忘了，但是没关系，我自己来。
没关系.en: Although you forgot, it's okay; I'll do it myself.

姐.en: My elder sister is at work.
Sis, help me grab my backpack.
She is my cousin (older), not my biological sister.
My elder sister is three years older than me.

姐.zh: 因为姐不在家，所以我自己做饭。
姐.en: Because my sister isn't home, I cook for myself.

坐下.en: After he sat down, he started eating.
Sit down; I have something to tell you.

坐下.zh: 别站着，快坐下休息一下。
坐下.en: Don't stand; sit down and rest for a bit.

坐下.zh: 大家坐下，然后我们开会。
坐下.en: Everyone sit down, and then we'll have the meeting.

零.en: I only have small change in my wallet.

零.zh: 从一到一百，别忘了写零。
零.en: From one to one hundred, don't forget to write zero.

零.zh: 虽然努力了，但结果还是零。
零.en: Although I worked hard, the result was still zero.

桌子.en: There is a book on the table.
Please put the cup on the table.

桌子.zh: 这张桌子太大了，放不下。
桌子.en: This table is too big; it can't fit.

桌子.zh: 吃饭前先把桌子擦干净。
因为桌子坏了，所以我买了一张新的。
桌子.en: Because the table was broken, I bought a new one.

白天.en: It's very hot during the day.

白天.zh: 他白天上班，晚上学中文。
白天.en: He works during the day and studies Chinese at night.

白天.zh: 白天别睡太多，晚上会睡不着。
白天.en: Don't sleep too much during the day, or you won't sleep at night.

白天.zh: 虽然白天很忙，但是晚上有时间。
白天.en: Although I'm busy during the day, I have time in the evening.

白天.zh: 白天的时候我们去海边玩，晚上回家。
白天.en: During the day we go to the beach to play, and go home at night.

请问.en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
May I ask if you need help?
Excuse me, how much is this?
May I ask who you are?

请问.zh: 请问，如果我想退票应该怎么办？
请问.en: Excuse me, if I want to get a refund, what should I do?

哪些.zh: 这些水果里哪些是新鲜的？
哪些.en: Among these fruits, which ones are fresh?

哪些.zh: 哪些电影你看过，可以推荐一下吗？
哪些.en: Which movies have you seen, can you recommend some?

哪些.zh: 这次活动有哪些人参加，你知道吗？
哪些.en: Which people are participating in this event, do you know?

晚饭.en: What do you want for dinner?
I usually have dinner at six.

晚饭.zh: 妈妈做了我最爱吃的红烧肉当晚饭。
晚饭.en: Mom made my favorite braised pork for dinner.

晚饭.zh: 因为加班，所以我晚饭吃得很晚。
晚饭.en: Because I worked overtime, I had dinner very late.

小学.en: My younger sister is in elementary school.

小学.zh: 这所小学教学质量很好。
小学.en: This elementary school has good teaching quality.

小学.zh: 他小学的时候就开始学钢琴了。
小学.en: He started learning piano when he was in elementary school.

小学.zh: 我的小学老师对我影响很大。
小学.en: My elementary school teacher had a big influence on me.

小学.zh: 虽然小学已经毕业很久，但我还记得那些朋友。
小学.en: Although I graduated from elementary school long ago, I still remember those friends.

国外.zh: 她大学毕业后去了国外留学。
国外.en: She went abroad to study after graduating from university.

国外.zh: 我在国外旅行时认识了很多新朋友。
国外.en: I met many new friends while traveling abroad.

国外.zh: 如果你想去国外发展，语言很重要。
国外.en: If you want to develop abroad, language is very important.

饭店.en: Which restaurant are we going to tonight?

饭店.zh: 饭店的招牌菜是糖醋排骨。
饭店.en: The restaurant's signature dish is sweet and sour spare ribs.

饭店.zh: 那家饭店的服务员态度特别好。
饭店.en: The service staff at that restaurant have a very good attitude.

饭店.zh: 因为饭店太火，所以我们提前订了位子。
饭店.en: Because the restaurant is so popular, we booked a table in advance.

中学.zh: 这所中学的校服很好看。
中学.en: The uniform of this middle school looks nice.

中学.zh: 中学的课程比小学难多了。
中学.en: Middle school courses are much harder than elementary school.

中学.zh: 我中学时最喜欢上体育课。
中学.en: I liked PE class the most when I was in middle school.

中学.zh: 虽然中学很累，但那段时光也很珍贵。
中学.en: Although middle school was tiring, that time was also precious.

楼下.zh: 楼下那家店的咖啡特别好喝。
楼下.en: The coffee at the shop downstairs is especially good.

楼下.zh: 如果楼下太吵，你就戴上耳机。
楼下.en: If it's too noisy downstairs, just put on your earphones.

面包.en: I eat bread in the morning.

面包.zh: 面包店每天都要做很多面包。
面包.en: The bakery makes a lot of bread every day.

面包.zh: 他喜欢在面包上抹花生酱。
面包.en: He likes to spread peanut butter on bread.

面包.zh: 因为面包快过期了，所以我打算做成面包屑。
面包.en: Because the bread is about to expire, I plan to make breadcrumbs.

生病.zh: 你看起来很累，是不是生病了？
生病.en: You look tired, are you sick?

生病.zh: 最近天气变化大，很多人容易生病。
生病.en: The weather has been changing a lot recently; many people easily get sick.

生病.zh: 她生病请假了，今天没来上班。
生病.en: She took leave because she is sick; she didn't come to work today.

生病.zh: 如果生病了，一定要多喝水好好休息。
生病.en: If you get sick, make sure to drink plenty of water and rest well.

好听.zh: 我觉得她的声音很好听，像小鸟一样。
好听.en: I think her voice is very pleasant, like a little bird.

好听.zh: 这首新歌虽然简单，但是很好听。
好听.en: This new song is simple, but it sounds very good.

好听.zh: 你说话的声音真好听，可以多说几句吗？
好听.en: Your speaking voice is so nice, can you say a few more words?

好听.zh: 大家都说这曲子好听，所以我学了好久。
好听.en: Everyone says this tune is beautiful, so I studied it for a long time.

钱包.zh: 昨天我在超市买了一个新钱包。
钱包.en: Yesterday I bought a new wallet at the supermarket.
Do you have your ID card in your wallet?

钱包.zh: 因为钱包不见了，所以我很着急。
钱包.en: Because my wallet is missing, I'm very worried.

钱包.zh: 这个钱包是朋友送的，我特别喜欢。
钱包.en: This wallet was a gift from a friend, I really like it.

大学生.zh: 我姐姐是大学生，她学英语。
大学生.en: My older sister is a college student, she studies English.

大学生.zh: 很多大学生喜欢在图书馆学习。
大学生.en: Many college students like to study in the library.

大学生.zh: 虽然他是大学生，但做饭做得很好。
大学生.en: Although he is a college student, he cooks very well.

大学生.zh: 暑假的时候，大学生们常常去旅行。
大学生.en: During summer break, college students often go traveling.

超市.zh: 周末我常去超市买水果和牛奶。
超市.en: On weekends I often go to the supermarket to buy fruit and milk.

超市.zh: 超市就在我家楼下，很方便。
超市.en: The supermarket is just downstairs from my home, very convenient.

超市.zh: 因为超市要关门了，所以我买得很快。
超市.en: Because the supermarket was about to close, I shopped quickly.

超市.zh: 这家超市的东西很便宜，但人很多。
超市.en: This supermarket has cheap things, but it's very crowded.

椅子.en: Please move the chair to the living room.

椅子.zh: 教室里有很多椅子和桌子。
椅子.en: There are many chairs and desks in the classroom.

椅子.zh: 虽然椅子旧了，但坐着还挺稳。
椅子.en: Although the chair is old, sitting on it is still quite steady.

椅子.zh: 你坐那把椅子吧，我坐地上就行。
椅子.en: You sit on that chair, I'll just sit on the floor.

小朋友.en: Little kid, how old are you?

小朋友.zh: 公园里有很多小朋友在玩耍。
小朋友.en: There are many children playing in the park.

小朋友.zh: 小朋友们都喜欢听老师讲故事。
小朋友.en: The children all like to listen to the teacher tell stories.

小朋友.zh: 因为小朋友太小了，所以需要大人陪着。
小朋友.en: Because the child is too young, an adult needs to accompany them.

小朋友.zh: 这位小朋友，你的气球掉了。
小朋友.en: Little kid, your balloon fell off.

北京.zh: 我去年去过北京，看了长城。
北京.en: I went to Beijing last year and saw the Great Wall.

北京.zh: 北京烤鸭很好吃，你一定要尝尝。
北京.en: Beijing roast duck is delicious, you must try it.

北京.zh: 虽然北京冬天很冷，但我还是想去。
北京.en: Although winter in Beijing is very cold, I still want to go.

北京.zh: 他住在北京，所以常常去故宫玩。
北京.en: He lives in Beijing, so he often goes to the Forbidden City.

不大.zh: 虽然房子不大，但是很温馨。
不大.en: Although the house is not big, it's very cozy.

不大.zh: 他的胃口不大，吃不了太多。
不大.en: His appetite is not big, he can't eat too much.

不大.zh: 这件衣服不大不小，刚刚好。
不大.en: This piece of clothing is neither too big nor too small, just right.

不大.zh: 问题不大，我们慢慢解决。
不大.en: The problem is not big, we'll solve it slowly.

午饭.zh: 我一般十二点吃午饭，然后休息一下。
午饭.en: I usually have lunch at twelve, then rest a bit.

午饭.zh: 今天午饭我们吃面条吧。
午饭.en: Let's have noodles for lunch today.

午饭.zh: 因为早上吃多了，所以午饭我只吃了一点。
午饭.en: Because I ate too much in the morning, I only had a little lunch.

午饭.zh: 她每天都会带自己做的午饭去公司。
午饭.en: She brings her own homemade lunch to the office every day.

上车.zh: 公共汽车来了，我们快上车。
上车.en: The bus is coming, let's get on quickly.
After getting in the car, please fasten your seatbelt.

上车.zh: 他先上车，然后帮我开了门。
上车.en: He got in the car first, then opened the door for me.

上车.zh: 因为下雨了，上车后我马上把伞收了。
上车.en: Because it was raining, I put away my umbrella as soon as I got in the car.

楼上.zh: 我住在楼上，你来找我吧。
楼上.en: I live upstairs, come find me.
Upstairs is too noisy, I can't sleep.

楼上.zh: 因为楼上漏水，所以我们要修。
楼上.en: Because upstairs is leaking, we need to fix it.

打球.zh: 他每天下午都去操场打球。
打球.en: He goes to the playground to play ball every afternoon.

打球.zh: 周末我喜欢和朋友一起打球。
打球.en: On weekends I like to play ball with friends.

打球.zh: 虽然下雨了，但他还是想打球。
打球.en: Although it's raining, he still wants to play ball.

做饭.zh: 我不会做饭，常常叫外卖。
做饭.en: I can't cook, often order takeout.
Cooking takes a lot of time.

下雨.en: It's raining outside, remember to bring an umbrella.
On rainy days I just want to sleep.

下雨.zh: 因为下雨，所以比赛取消了。
下雨.en: Because it's raining, the match is cancelled.

下车.en: Please get off at the next stop.
I missed my stop, forgot to get off.
Wait until the car stops before getting off.

下车.zh: 他下车后才发现手机丢了。
下车.en: He only realized he lost his phone after getting off.

杯子.zh: 如果你渴了，就用这个杯子喝水。
杯子.en: If you're thirsty, use this cup to drink water.
There are three cups on the table.

中文.zh: 虽然中文很难，但很有意思。
中文.en: Although Chinese is hard, it's very interesting.

中文.zh: 你可以用中文写作业吗？
中文.en: Can you do homework in Chinese?

弟.en: His younger brother is taller than my younger brother.
My younger brother likes playing soccer.

电视机.zh: 因为电视机坏了，所以我们看不了电影。
电视机.en: Because the TV is broken, we can't watch the movie.

电视机.zh: 他把电视机搬到了卧室。
电视机.en: He moved the TV to the bedroom.

早饭.en: What do you want for breakfast?

早饭.zh: 如果来不及，早饭可以带在路上吃。
早饭.en: If in a hurry, you can take breakfast to eat on the way.

一点儿.zh: 你能不能给我一点儿时间？
一点儿.en: Can you give me a little time?

一点儿.zh: 他一点儿也不喜欢这个电影。
一点儿.en: He doesn't like this movie at all.

一点儿.zh: 请慢一点儿说，我听不清。
一点儿.en: Please speak a little slower, I can't hear clearly.

一点儿.zh: 今天比昨天冷一点儿，多穿件衣服吧。
一点儿.en: Today is a bit colder than yesterday, wear more clothes.

书店.en: I'm going to the bookstore to buy books.
This bookstore has a very complete selection.

书店.zh: 我经常在书店看书，但不一定买。
书店.en: I often read books in the bookstore, but not necessarily buy.

书店.zh: 书店旁边有一家咖啡馆，环境很好。
书店.en: There's a coffee shop next to the bookstore, the atmosphere is great.

关上.zh: 他关上电脑就去睡觉了。
关上.en: He turned off the computer and went to sleep.

关上.zh: 你走的时候记得关上灯。
关上.en: Remember to turn off the light when you leave.

关上.zh: 外面太吵了，快把窗户关上。
关上.en: It's too noisy outside, quickly close the window.

火车站.en: The train station is far from here.
Let's meet at the train station.

火车站.zh: 这个火车站很大，有十几个站台。
火车站.en: This train station is very big, with over a dozen platforms.
Which bus goes to the train station?

火车站.zh: 我昨天在火车站等了一个小时，车才来。
火车站.en: I waited for an hour at the train station yesterday before the train came.

玩儿.en: The kids are playing in the park.
Where shall we go to have fun on the weekend?

玩儿.zh: 我们一起去海边玩儿吧。
玩儿.en: Let's go to the beach and have fun together.

星期天.zh: 星期天我们一起去爬山吧。
星期天.en: Let's go hiking together on Sunday.

星期天.zh: 他每个星期天都去图书馆学习。
星期天.en: He goes to the library to study every Sunday.

星期天.zh: 星期天早上我通常睡懒觉，十点才起床。
星期天.en: On Sunday mornings I usually sleep in and don't get up until ten.

车票.en: I bought a ticket for tomorrow.

车票.zh: 他忘记带车票了，进不了站。
车票.en: He forgot to bring his ticket and couldn't enter the station.

车票.zh: 在网上可以提前买火车票，很方便。
车票.en: You can buy train tickets online in advance, it's very convenient.

看病.en: I need to go to the hospital to see a doctor.
You're sick, go see a doctor quickly.

看病.zh: 看病要排队，可能要等很久。
看病.en: Seeing a doctor requires queuing, it might take a long time.
He took leave today to go see a doctor.

看病.zh: 最近身体不舒服，得去看病才行。
看病.en: I've been feeling unwell lately, I have to go see a doctor.

电影院.zh: 我们去看电影吧，电影院很近。
电影院.en: Let's go see a movie, the cinema is very close.

电影院.zh: 这个电影院很大，有十个放映厅。
电影院.en: This cinema is very big, with ten screening rooms.

电影院.zh: 电影院门口有很多人在排队。
电影院.en: There are many people queuing at the cinema entrance.
Excuse me, how do I get to the cinema?

电影院.zh: 他喜欢在电影院看电影，觉得效果更好。
电影院.en: He likes watching movies at the cinema, thinks the effect is better.

下课.en: Class ends at three in the afternoon.
After class I'm going to play ball.

下课.zh: 他一下课就跑了，好像有急事。
下课.en: He ran off as soon as class ended, as if he had something urgent.

下课.zh: 今天老师没有准时下课，多讲了十分钟。
下课.en: Today the teacher didn't dismiss class on time, he talked for an extra ten minutes.

米饭.en: Today's rice is a bit hard.

米饭.zh: 我要一碗米饭和一个菜。
米饭.en: I want a bowl of rice and a dish.

米饭.zh: 他吃米饭的时候喜欢加酱油。
米饭.en: He likes to add soy sauce when eating rice.

米饭.zh: 因为米饭不够了，我又煮了一些。
米饭.en: Because there wasn't enough rice, I cooked some more.

米饭.zh: 这家店的米饭又香又软，很多人都来吃。
米饭.en: The rice at this restaurant is fragrant and soft, so many people come to eat.

里边.zh: 这个盒子里边装的是礼物。
里边.en: Inside this box is a gift.

里边.zh: 你试试看，里边应该有你喜欢的颜色。
里边.en: Take a look; inside there should be a color you like.

里边.zh: 房子里边很干净，但是院子里有点乱。
里边.en: The inside of the house is very clean, but the yard is a bit messy.

里边.zh: 他走进房间，发现里边一个人都没有。
里边.en: He walked into the room and found no one inside.

有点儿.en: This dish is a bit salty.

有点儿.zh: 她说话的声音有点儿小，我听不清楚。
有点儿.en: Her voice is a bit soft; I can't hear clearly.

有点儿.zh: 虽然有点儿贵，但是质量很好。
有点儿.en: Although it's a bit expensive, the quality is very good.

有点儿.zh: 等了这么久，我都有点儿不耐烦了。
有点儿.en: Having waited so long, I'm getting a bit impatient.

没事儿.zh: 他跟我说没事儿，但我还是有点担心。
没事儿.en: He told me it's fine, but I'm still a little worried.

没事儿.zh: 没事儿，我可以自己回家。
没事儿.en: It's okay, I can go home by myself.

没事儿.zh: 就算失败了也没事儿，我们再试一次。
没事儿.en: Even if we fail, it's fine; we'll try again.

没事儿.zh: 他摔倒了，但他说没事儿，就继续跑了。
没事儿.en: He fell, but he said it was nothing and kept running.

饺子.zh: 今天中午我们包饺子吧。
饺子.en: Let's make dumplings for lunch today.

饺子.zh: 妈妈做的饺子特别好吃。
饺子.en: The dumplings my mom makes are especially delicious.

饺子.zh: 如果饺子不够吃，我可以再煮一些。
饺子.en: If there aren't enough dumplings, I can cook some more.

饺子.zh: 过年的时候，我们全家一起包饺子吃。
饺子.en: During the New Year, our whole family makes and eats dumplings together.

小学生.en: He is a third-grade elementary school student.

小学生.zh: 那个小学生背着书包去上学。
小学生.en: That elementary school student is carrying a backpack to school.

小学生.zh: 小学生们在操场上跑步。
小学生.en: The elementary school students are running on the playground.

小学生.zh: 虽然他是小学生，但已经会写很多字了。
小学生.en: Although he is an elementary school student, he already knows how to write many characters.

小学生.zh: 老师让小学生每天都要读课外书。
小学生.en: The teacher tells the elementary school students to read extracurricular books every day.

外边.zh: 外边太吵了，我们进去说话吧。
外边.en: It's too noisy outside; let's go inside to talk.
He has been waiting for you outside for a long time.

外边.zh: 如果外边冷，你就多穿件衣服。
外边.en: If it's cold outside, put on more clothes.

外边.zh: 外边有很多人，我们得小心一点儿。
外边.en: There are many people outside; we need to be a bit careful.

中学生.zh: 他是个初中生吗？不，他是中学生。
中学生.en: Is he a junior high student? No, he's a middle school student.

中学生.zh: 这个中学生每天骑自行车上学。
中学生.en: This middle school student rides a bike to school every day.

中学生.zh: 中学生课业比较重，晚上常常要写作业。
中学生.en: Middle school students have heavy coursework and often have to do homework at night.

中学生.zh: 她虽然只是中学生，但已经立志要当医生了。
中学生.en: Although she is only a middle school student, she has already decided to become a doctor.

中学生.zh: 学校和家长都应该多关心中学生的心理健康。
中学生.en: Schools and parents should both pay attention to middle school students' mental health.

星期日.en: Let's go to the park on Sunday.
I have to work overtime this Sunday.

星期日.zh: 星期日早上我通常睡到很晚。
星期日.en: On Sunday mornings I usually sleep late.

星期日.zh: 如果星期日天气好，我们就去爬山。
星期日.en: If the weather is nice on Sunday, we'll go hiking.

星期日.zh: 星期日是一周的最后一天，很多人都会休息。
星期日.en: Sunday is the last day of the week, and many people rest.

汉语.en: I can speak a little Chinese.

汉语.zh: 我正在学汉语，觉得很有意思。
汉语.en: I am learning Chinese and find it very interesting.

汉语.zh: 虽然汉语很难，但我一定要学好它。
汉语.en: Although Chinese is hard, I must learn it well.

汉语.zh: 用汉语跟中国人聊天能学得更快。
汉语.en: Chatting with Chinese people in Chinese can help you learn faster.

后边.zh: 你走后边，我在前边带路。
后边.en: You walk behind, I'll lead the way in front.
The backpack is on the chair behind.

后边.zh: 因为后边太吵，我们换到了前边。
后边.en: Because it was too noisy in the back, we moved to the front.
Is there a restroom in the back?

西边.en: His home is to the west.

西边.zh: 太阳从西边落下，东边升起。
西边.en: The sun sets in the west and rises in the east.

西边.zh: 如果你往西边一直走，就能看到公园。
西边.en: If you keep walking west, you'll see the park.
There's a mountain to the west.

西边.zh: 我们住在城市的西边，离公司很近。
西边.en: We live in the west part of the city, very close to the company.

上边.en: There's dust on top of the book.

上边.zh: 把手机放桌子上边，别放包里。
上边.en: Put the phone on the table, not in the bag.

上边.zh: 上边和下边不一样，你要看清楚。
上边.en: The top and bottom are different, you need to see clearly.
The name is written on top.

上边.zh: 我住楼上边，她住楼下边。
上边.en: I live upstairs, she lives downstairs.

东边.en: The school is to the east.

东边.zh: 东边的日出特别好看，我们明早去看。
东边.en: The sunrise in the east is especially beautiful; let's go watch it tomorrow morning.

东边.zh: 虽然东边更近，但我还是喜欢去西边。
东边.en: Although the east is closer, I still prefer going to the west.
There's a supermarket to the east.

东边.zh: 你往东边看，就能看到那座高楼。
东边.en: If you look east, you'll see that tall building.

包子.zh: 早上我吃了两个包子和一杯豆浆。
包子.en: In the morning I ate two buns and a cup of soy milk.

包子.zh: 因为包子太烫了，我等了一会儿才吃。
包子.en: Because the buns were too hot, I waited a while before eating.
The buns at this place are delicious.

包子.zh: 妈妈包了包子，有猪肉和白菜馅的。
包子.en: Mom made buns, with pork and cabbage fillings.

不客气.en: You're welcome, you are too polite.
Everyone, don't be polite, it's my treat.

不客气.zh: 他说不客气的时候，我反而更不好意思了。
不客气.en: When he said 'you're welcome', I felt even more embarrassed.

不客气.zh: 如果还有问题，不客气尽管问。
不客气.en: If you have any more questions, don't be polite and just ask.

南边.en: There's a lake to the south.

南边.zh: 我们公司南边有一家很棒的餐厅。
南边.en: There's a great restaurant to the south of our company.

南边.zh: 如果你往南边走，就会看到地铁站。
南边.en: If you walk south, you'll see the subway station.
The south is warmer than the north.

南边.zh: 他住在城市南边，上班要坐一个小时地铁。
南边.en: He lives in the south of the city, takes an hour subway to work.

北边.zh: 冬天的北边经常下雪，你要多穿衣服。
北边.en: In winter, the north often snows, you need to wear more clothes.

北边.zh: 虽然北边远，但风景很好。
北边.en: Although the north is far, the scenery is very good.
There's a bridge to the north.

北边.zh: 我们从北边出发，开了两个小时才到。
北边.en: We started from the north and drove for two hours to arrive.

下边.en: There's a kitten under the table.

下边.zh: 上边和下边都放了东西，你找找看。
下边.en: Things are placed both above and below, take a look.

下边.zh: 我住在下边那层楼，你可以坐电梯下来。
下边.en: I live on the floor below, you can take the elevator down.

汉字.en: This Chinese character is hard to write.

汉字.zh: 我每天学十个汉字，慢慢积累。
汉字.en: I learn ten Chinese characters every day, accumulating slowly.

汉字.zh: 因为汉字太多了，所以记起来不容易。
汉字.en: Because there are so many Chinese characters, it's not easy to memorize them.

汉字.zh: 你要多练习写汉字，手写和打字不一样。
汉字.en: You need to practice writing Chinese characters more; handwriting is different from typing.

请进.en: Please come in, the door is unlocked.
Please come in, don't stand outside.
Please come in, we are waiting for you.
Please come in, it's too cold outside.
If you are ready, please come in.

好玩儿.zh: 那里真好玩儿，我们下次再去。
好玩儿.en: That place is really fun, let's go again next time.

好玩儿.zh: 你觉不觉得这个电影很好玩儿？
好玩儿.en: Don't you think this movie is very fun?

好玩儿.zh: 虽然有点儿累，但是爬山很好玩儿。
好玩儿.en: Although a bit tired, climbing the mountain was fun.

好玩儿.zh: 周末我们一起找一个好玩儿的地方吧。
好玩儿.en: Let's find a fun place together this weekend.

前边.zh: 你一直走，前边就是车站。
前边.en: Go straight, the station is ahead.

前边.zh: 我们的座位在前边第三排。
前边.en: Our seats are in the third row ahead.

前边.zh: 前边的那个人是我哥哥。
前边.en: The person in front is my older brother.

前边.zh: 因为前边堵车，所以我们迟到了。
前边.en: Because there was a traffic jam ahead, we were late.

教学楼.en: Our teaching building is very new.

教学楼.zh: 教学楼前边有一棵大树。
教学楼.en: There is a big tree in front of the teaching building.

教学楼.zh: 每天八点我就去教学楼上课。
教学楼.en: I go to the teaching building for class at eight every day.

教学楼.zh: 你从教学楼出来，右转就到了。
教学楼.en: Come out of the teaching building and turn right, you'll arrive.

请坐.en: Please sit down, don't be polite.

请坐.zh: 请坐在这里，等一会儿医生就来。
请坐.en: Please sit here, the doctor will come in a moment.

请坐.zh: 如果累了，就请坐一会儿。
请坐.en: If you are tired, please sit for a while.

半年.en: I have studied Chinese for half a year.
He has been in Beijing for half a year.

半年.zh: 半年时间很快就过去了。
半年.en: Half a year passed very quickly.

半年.zh: 因为工作，我要在国外住半年。
半年.en: Because of work, I will live abroad for half a year.

半年.zh: 这个项目大概需要半年才能完成。
半年.en: This project will probably take half a year to complete.

听写.en: There is a dictation test tomorrow.
I got all the dictation correct today.

听写.zh: 老师每周都会做一次听写。
听写.en: The teacher gives a dictation once a week.

听写.zh: 虽然听写很难，但是对我的中文有帮助。
听写.en: Although dictation is hard, it helps my Chinese.

面条儿.zh: 今天中午我们吃面条儿吧。
面条儿.en: Let's eat noodles for lunch today.
This bowl of noodles is so delicious.

面条儿.zh: 妈妈做的面条儿比外面的好吃。
面条儿.en: The noodles mom makes are tastier than the ones outside.

面条儿.zh: 如果饿的话，你可以先煮点面条儿吃。
面条儿.en: If you're hungry, you can cook some noodles first.

一下儿.en: Can you help me a bit?

一下儿.zh: 让我想一下儿再回答你。
一下儿.en: Let me think a moment before answering you.

一下儿.zh: 你用一下儿这个电脑试试。
一下儿.en: Try using this computer for a bit.

一下儿.zh: 因为太吵了，所以我休息了一下儿。
一下儿.en: Because it was too noisy, I rested for a bit.

有一些.en: I have some more questions to ask.
There are some books and pens on the table.

有一些.zh: 虽然有一些难，但是很有意思。
有一些.en: Although it's a bit difficult, it's very interesting.

有一些.zh: 你包里还有有一些钱吗？
有一些.en: Do you still have some money in your bag?
